title: Research candidate
description: One evaluated data-source candidate from the research-sources skill. File name: research/candidates/<slug>.json

slug.description: Matches the file name and memo slug.

url.description: Canonical docs/landing page, not a deep API endpoint.

license.description: License/ToS summary; must note any clause blocking commercial/product use.

cost.description: Must confirm actually free, not a trial, and any rate limit.

auth.description: 'none' or what's required, e.g. 'free registration key (like CENSUS_API_KEY)'.

history.description: How far back the series goes; a backtest needs real depth.

correlation.description: Quantitative evaluation against FHFA HPI / Zillow ZORI, if app/research/evaluate_series.py exists and was run. Null if not computed, with a note why in recommendation.

integration_notes.description: How it would plug into sources.yaml / app/sources/, and what existing metric or hardcoded assumption it would replace or supplement.

recommendation.description: One paragraph: recommend / don't recommend, and why.
